provenance.source: Tonelli et al. 2019, Methods pp. 856-858, Peripersonal space task (DOI 10.1007/s00221-019-05469-3): targets 500 ms before sound onset and 500 ms after sound offset; 3000-ms motion and 20-ms vibration; no fixed ITI. The software margins and 100-ms cue are explicitly separate implementation choices with their formula in reference_parameters.
Methods report 140 trials: 28 tactile-only, 28 catch, and 12 trials for each audio-tactile combination.
Methods report a seven-speaker array with 17 cm between loudspeakers.

notes: This manifest audits recreation inside the PPS Toolkit GUI. It distinguishes toolkit-generated recreations of reported parameters from the original authors' exact stimulus set.
